notes.title: Kingdom Crier #44: Work QOL, Evangelizing, Skill Caps, Presets
notes.notes:
Kingdom Crier #44 is here alongside Version v0.30.4 which includes Work QOL improvements, Evangelizing, raised Skill Caps, Mortal Presets, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/3b3676cea1ff045233b0da16e40d296daecbdca8.gif[/img]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[h2]Work QOL[/h2]
We spent some time improving Work Prioritization and added some new tools to better understand why your Mortals are or are not doing something.

[h3]Work Queue[/h3]
We found that a number of instances of work inefficiencies came down to having insufficient information to make decisions, so we've added the Work Tab to the Mortal Sheet.

The Work Tab houses the Work Queue which shows all of the Work that a Mortal considers their responsibility, listed in order that they'll tackle it as of their last evaluation.

Prioritization has been refined and is based on the following criteria, in order: Critical Work > Personal Commands > Work > Prioritized Jobs > Job Priority (low to high) > Rushed Commands > Job Sequence (low to high) > Command Priority (low to high). Ties are resolved using the appropriate heuristic for that Command - Age for Construction Commands, Distance for Store Commands, for example.

Hover over a Command to see why it is where it is in the Queue. Click on a Command to jump to its position in the world. If you expect to see something listed, but it isn't, double check that Mortal's Job Assignments and wait until their next evaluation.

[i]So much to do![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/f7051ca6836cf8055152e399a8b74b01550988f8.png[/img]

Use the information you gather here to make adjustments to direct your Mortals to the work they should be doing.

[h4]Examples[/h4]
Change Job Priorities to move all of the work from one Job in front of another.

Prioritize a Job to move it in front of all other Jobs for anyone assigned.

Rush a Command to move it to the front of work to be done within that Job.

Raise a Command's Priority (where relevant) to move it around relative to other instances of the same Command.

[h4]Common Problems[/h4]
Prioritizing Jobs can starve other Jobs. This can be resolved by unassigning the Prioritized Job from the Mortals you want to perform the other Jobs or by Prioritizing that Job as well. Prioritizing multiple Jobs can compound the issue by starving even more Jobs, so use it prudently.

Rushing too many Commands can cause delays in important logistical Work. Rushing a bunch of Store Commands, for example, will introduce delays in Refueling heat sources. De-rush those Store Commands and instead increase (lower) the Priority of their Assigned Storage to move them to the front of the Store Queue without affecting Refueling.

[h3]Schedule Screen[/h3]
The Schedule Screen has received a much needed makeover with Copy/Paste support, individual Autonomous Toggles, and the retention of custom Schedules when put into Autonomous mode.

[i]Take it easy for a bit...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/7e11df4213a263b35dc5ae972fa490706585ecd3.png[/img]

[h3]Character Pathing[/h3]
One thing that popped out during this evaluation was Character Pathing - which introduced small delays whenever a Mortal reached their next local Pathing target and computed the next leg of their path.

We resolved this by kicking off the next Pathing request as they approach their destination. This also improved Pathing visualization and resolved a number of back and forth Pathing scenarios.

[h3]Jobs Screen[/h3]
We've done a pass on the Jobs Screen to give the headers more room to breathe and added an updated tooltip to them that includes the Job Sequence (the order that Commands are executed within a Job).

[h2]Evangelizing[/h2]
While fun in spurts, speaking to Mortals via your Ruler can be laborious and isn't everyone's cup of tea, so we've added Evangelizing. Evangelizing tasks your Preachers with improving a Mortal's Esteem (Opinion of your Ruler). To Evangelize your Ruler to someone, click on the Mortal and click the Evangelize button or press 'E'.

When Evangelizing, your Preachers share Information about your Ruler with the Mortal that they know the Mortal will Like. Other Mortals that are nearby may react to that information as well. The strength of the reactions are dictated by your Preacher's Skill.

[i]Tell her Sylvester![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/9afb61407e2778e996f5b4f4c18fd29e5b2c8c88.png[/img]

Preachers are unable to get Mortals who Hate your Ruler to listen to them. In addition, they'll stop once the Mortal Likes your Ruler unless Ordered (via Right-Click) - in which case they'll continue until the Mortal Loves your Ruler.

[h3]When to Evangelize[/h3]
This is a great way to improve the Trade deals you get from a Visitor or butter them up before asking them to Join. It can help if you need to smooth over Poor Opinion from the occasional Noble or two.

[h3]When not to Evangelize[/h3]
It isn't the answer when a Noble Hates your ruler - check their Esteem tab to identify and resolve the issue that is bothering them in those cases.

[h2]Raised Skill Caps[/h2]
Next we increased the Skill Caps to 40 which means a Mortal can continue to reap the benefits of equipping the best gear for their Job when they've reached the natural limit of 20. 

Exceeding Skills beyond the natural limit will allow their use to reach new heights where appropriate.

[h2]Mortal Presets[/h2]
Mortal Presets allow you to capture a snapshot of any Mortal including their Details, Skills, Appearance, and Opinions for use in another game. 

Open the Editor for any Mortal and click the new Save button in the upper right to capture a snapshot of them as a Preset.

Apply them by editing a Mortal that's part of the Heavy is the Crown Intro or an Origin Story from the Living World and choosing Apply in the upper right.

These are saved as separate files in the Noble Fates save game directory and are synchronized via Steam Cloud.

[h2]Mortal Editor[/h2]
The Mortal Editor has been updated so that the full ranges for each setting are available, regardless of your Character Visuals Goofiness setting.

Generation and Randomize will still respect your setting, but you can push any Mortals you'd like beyond the limits.

[h2]Load Game Screen[/h2]
We've added the ability to filter the Load Game screen by name. You can Bulk Delete saves by entering a Filter and choosing the Delete X Listed Button at the bottom right.

[h3]Warning[/h3]
Deleting a Save no longer sends it to the Recycle Bin because of usability issues this introduces on Windows 11 and Linux - so when a Save is deleted, it's deleted [b]PERMANENTLY[/b].

notes.title: Kingdom Crier #43: Performance, System Demands, Roadmap
notes.notes:
Kingdom Crier #43 is here alongside Version v0.30.3 which brings improvements to Performance and decreased strain on System Resources.

Also, let's update the Roadmap!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/7dec040180e7489b51223cf180e1212adcadba36.gif[/img]
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[h2]Shadows[/h2]
Shadows have been the most expensive thing to render in Noble Fates for a while now - our far view distances and the use of multiple cascades meant that most of the world was rendered multiple times each frame. Given Unity's architecture this meant that up to 1/2 of the CPU cost and GPU cost of Rendering was spent on Shadows!

We've reworked High to cut CPU and GPU cost in half by dropping to a single cascade and better utilizing the Shadow resolution. We've also retuned Shadows to minimize rendering artifacts (banding) and maximize quality.

In addition, we've added 2 new Shadow Settings. Very High will yield increased quality at the cost of System Resources. Medium strikes the middle ground between High and Low.

[h2]Portraits[/h2]
Live Portraits are one of the cornerstones of the Noble Fates experience, but they have always been very expensive - coming in at ~5ms per-frame for 10. With this patch, we've been able to cut the cost by 75% - down to ~1.25ms!

To do this, we switched from rendering custom picture in picture cameras attached to rigs that follow your mortals around to batched rendering using a command buffer to capture only what we need without all of the extra overhead of Unity's camera rendering system.

In addition, this armed us to do a consistency pass across Portraits, meaning the lighting in Live Portraits and Headshots (the static Mortal images used everywhere else) now have a consistent appearance, regardless of the current lighting conditions in the world!

[h2]Footstep Decals[/h2]
Footstep Decals clocked in at ~5ms on the CPU - with nearly half of this time spent re-rendering any objects that could receive Footstep Decals into a special buffer to identify the areas of the screen that could receive them.

We discovered some tricks we can play on Unity's rendering architecture to plumb through the identifying information we needed without an extra rendering step and in a more accurate way.

This allowed us to cut the cost of Footsteps in half and resolve the sorting artifacts that would occur before. In addition, this made it free to add Footsteps to Carpets!

[h2]Frame Rate Limit[/h2]
Frame Rate Limits stop the Rendering side of Unity from abusing System Resources when CPU demand is low.

In our game, this can happen often - the demands on your CPU drop dramatically when the simulation is paused or when your on any one of a number of Fullscreen UI pages that continue to render the world below them. This can cause the framerate to spike unexpectedly and can cause a much greater than expected demands on the GPU.

Recently, we included the ability to set a Frame Rate Limit even when VSync was enabled. Now, we've set a default of 60fps. If you find the game asking too much of your GPU, you can drop it down to 30fps which will greatly limit the strain on your GPU.

[h2]Reachability CPU Resources[/h2]
Finally, the arrival of the Reachability CPU thread increased the CPU demand of the game. That thread was allowed to run as fast as possible, exchanging CPU time for nearly no delay in updates to the Pathing System and Reachability.

This improvement took us from the 30s or so of latency prior to the Conquest Update to .25s or so (a 100x improvement!), but doubled the CPU's workload.

The reality, however, is that the sweet spot is something like a 25% increase in CPU workload in exchange for ~1s of Pathing latency (still a 30x improvement!), so we've set the default there.

This should result in imperceptible lag in Pathing updates, but if you find yourself with the occasional Unreachable error just after punching through a Wall, adding a new Bridge, or Terraforming - try cranking this setting up.

[h2]Summary[/h2]
All in all, you should see a reasonable reduction in System Demands, improved FPS, and increased Quality!

As always, there's more to do here, and there's still another pass or two planned during EA.

Expect occasional issues - but know that we appreciate you helping us make the game better!

[h1]Roadmap Update![/h1]
Let's take a moment to update the Roadmap and cross off a few boxes!

These days, there are 3 types of updates for Noble Fates - Hotfix Updates that address bugs and issues (including those that are listed on the Backlog and those that you Report in-game); Minor Updates that focus on reworking or expanding existing systems and filling them with additional content; and Feature Updates that add new features to the game expanding the overall breadth of what the game has to offer.

NOTE: We've replaced Content Updates with Minor Updates to better encompass the work that is being done to rework and expand on existing Systems during the march to 1.0.

[h2]Priority Progress[/h2]

[h2]Current Priorities[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/848a69c93667a25de5fac7f5df6be8ef003463ee.png[/img]
Some new entries here - including Fortress Mod support, Savable Mortal Presets, and allowing Buffs to exceed Skill Caps. We think these changes will better round out the whole experience as we head towards 1.0.

[h2]Feature Updates[/h2]
Finally, we have the Feature Updates. As a reminder, 8 of these will arrive during Early Access. 7 have landed so far. The most recent was Feature Update 7.

[i]Feature Update #7 - Noble Fates: Conquest![/i]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1769420/view/527588640879019600?l=english"][/dynamiclink]

Our biggest update to date, Noble Fates: Conquest greatly expanded on the mid to late game introducing the ability to Conquer your Island via Diplomacy or Warfare.

[h2]Feature Update #8 Status Update: In Progress[/h2]
The 8th Feature Update is in progress, and we're excited to share more details soon.

[h2]Early Access Status[/h2]
We're around 85% of the way through what we aim to accomplish with Early Access. Current estimates have us at 12 months or so from 1.0 with Major Update #8 landing somewhere in the middle.

We're in good shape for landing 1.0, due to your continued support. As always, you have our sincere gratitude!

[h2]Post 1.0 Plans[/h2]
We plan to support the game with a series of Hotfixes and Minor Updates that ensure the game is well balanced, performs well, and has consistent usability.

From there, the game could see subsequent Major Updates in one form or another depending on where things sit when the dust settles.

notes.title: Kingdom Crier #42: Storage v2, NPC Raids, Optimizations
notes.notes:
Kingdom Crier #42 is here alongside Version v0.30.2 which brings Storage v2, Optimizations, and other quality of life improvements. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/f8e742a744f989205cdf88acb34b5dc20a63ac61.gif[/img]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[h2]Storage v2[/h2]
Storage has been reworked to be Item centric instead of Storage Slot centric. 

Previously, Store Commands were issued only when the Storage system had reserved a Storage Slot for it. This meant that if you had insufficient storage, the Item would not get a Store Command. In addition, in the late game, the latency of processing storage meant that it could take 30s or so for the system to try to reserve Storage Slots, meaning that it wasn't clear if you were out of Space or if the Item was awaiting a Storage Slot reservation!

To solve this, we've flipped the role of Store Commands - every Item that belongs to your Kingdom and is not yet Stored automatically gets a Store Command. The Command is marked as Pending when the Item has not yet reserved a Storage Slot, and it is marked as Blocked when you have Insufficient Storage for it. This means you can check the status of any loose Item in the world by clicking on it (and prioritize it), even if it has not yet been evaluated.

In addition, we added a high level Storage Status icon when you're at home next to the Food Remaining Status Icon. It shows the percentage of Storage Slots in your Kingdom that are not used or reserved and changes color when there's a Warning or a Problem. Hovering over the Icon shows the breakdown of Storage Slots as well as counts for any non-Junk Item types that have Insufficient Storage. We've added the same stats to Storage Props and Stockpiles to allow you to check the status for individual Storage areas by clicking on them (or double clicking in the case of Shelves).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/3c97107323bc13c7af0796c2c26150229ebc4c29.png[/img]

Finally, we took this opportunity to revisit Hauling prioritization trying to better find the balance between distance traveled and storage priority.

It's worth noting is that you will see more Store commands than you did previously. Any loose, unstored Item or Stack will have one - and Stacks that are destined to be merged will have multiple (one for each separate Stack to be merged in). Generally, I kick on the Prioritize Toggle on the Jobs screen when Store Commands are above 150 or so and let it run until they're back under that threshold.

[h2]NPC Raid Tweaks[/h2]
Conquest launched with AI Kingdoms tuned heavily towards self preservation when interacting with the player. This meant that they wouldn't dispatch Raiding parties to attack you when at War if they didn't think they were stronger than you. Overall, this meant there was a large decrease in the number of incoming Raids, even if you were involved in multiple Wars.

Now, NPC Kingdoms will be more aggressive towards the player when at War - keeping you on your toes and spreading themselves thin at times to open up valuable opportunities for counter attack!

[h2]Optimizations[/h2]
We've dedicated a few days to Optimizations over the last few weeks, increasing the baseline Framerate for mid and late stage Kingdoms.

As always, there's more to do here, but this should help!

notes.title: Kingdom Crier #41: Welcome to Noble Fates: Conquest!
notes.notes:
Noble Fates: Conquest, the 7th Major Update for Noble Fates is here!

[i][b]Conquer your Island via Diplomacy and Warfare![/b][/i]
[i]Submit your base for use by other Kingdoms![/i]
[i]v0.29 saves are compatible![/i]

[i]Noble Fates: Conquest, courtesy of KoboldArt[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/5cb49268ca659509de6fb5df3f1663bf6f8709e9.png[/img]

[i]Noble Fates: Conquest trailer, courtesy of Matt[/i]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QMtDVZpTIT8

[h1]Features[/h1]
[h3]Visit and Raid other Kingdoms[/h3]
Send an Envoy to Improve Relations or Trade

Lead a Raiding Party to Declare War and Conquer your enemies!

[i]Bring the fight to them![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/6815a904671dadc79ee03ea9ac5934862f1ce4d9.gif[/img]

[h3]Conquer your Island[/h3]
The World Map has been updated to reflect each Kingdom's Might, their Holdings, and their known history.

[i]Chilljaw Atoll shall belong to the Orcs![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/7db5f65d94d774ded93e6612d180a2fb57ff11ad.png[/img]

A Kingdom's Holdings expand and contract based on their Strength relative to their neighbors.

Leverage a mix of Diplomacy and Warfare to unite the Island under your Beliefs or take them all out and stand as the only Kingdom, it's your call.

[h3]Engage in Diplomacy[/h3]
Rulers, including your own, can [i]Bend the Knee[/i] and swear Allegiance to another Kingdom to become their Vassals.

Build Influence with them to Negotiate their Allegiance, or beat them into submission and Demand it.

[i]Choose your path...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/a19fef446dc9460d6df18a418dd18bd3237f49c2.png[/img]

Call on them for support in times of need, but don't leave them in the lurch when they call on you!

[h3]Hire Mercenaries[/h3]
Some of the more ingenious Mortals have realized they can turn a profit selling their Skills as Mercenaries.

Place a Deposit and Hire them to expand your Workforce in a pinch...

Or turn your Coins into brute strength to turn the tide of a Battle that isn't going well...

[i]You want how much?!?!?![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/1c7725072cfcd47b8d6dbefe0844c480ebf82da8.png[/img]

Make sure they make it back home to get your Deposit back from the Mercenary Company!

[h3]Battering Rams[/h3]
Smacking Walls with Swords and Axes isn't a very effective way to knock them down.

Introducing the Battering Ram, a new Secondary piece of gear that Mortals can use to attack Props for additional Damage. Consequentially, Damage done to Props by Melee Weapons has been reduced.

[i]When a Door is in your way... You must Ram it![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/cf73a5b8fabd1a73a77c13e9ef709192a4553360.png[/img]

Prop Health has been rebalanced to better ensure Doors are (usually!) the weak point of a Structure. That said, a little scouting before engaging can yield weaknesses that are easier to exploit.

When attempting to breach a base, it's best to send a mix of Shields, Battering Rams, Hooks, and Ranged Weapons to Maximize your chance of success.

[h3]*NEW* Ballistas[/h3]
Ballistas are the hot new Defensive Prop sweeping Noberia.

[i]Put those Guards to use while you're waiting to see if your walls get Breached![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/fa814dd8ad767d9422156686c31a956de89af698.png[/img]

They work best against static targets like Archers, and especially well against Catapults.

Place some around your perimeter and mark them to be Operated and your Guards will occasionally stop by and scan for targets.

[h3]Fortresses[/h3]
We want the other Kingdoms in your world to live in bases worthy of their stature and to offer interesting Strategic challenges when Raiding, so we've introduced Fortresses.

Fortresses are snapshots of Player bases that can be instanced and used by the other Kingdoms in your world. They layer additional procedural elements and defensive strategies over the top of these to offer a variety of experiences.

We've added a Submit Fortress button to the Pause Menu. Use this to Submit your base for consideration to be used as a NPC base! Make sure to include your Contact Info so we can get in touch and give you proper Credit.

Note: it's best to avoid using Mods that introduce new Structures when building a base for submission as a Fortress, as it will limit your chances of selection.

[h3]Reworked Shields[/h3]
Shields have been Reworked to offer more Tactical choice. 

Use of a Shield is now toggleable when equipped. When wielded, the holder draws additional Aggro from nearby enemies, but they attack about half as often, and do not combo their attacks. 

In addition, Blocking has been rebalanced - yielding better results for Mortals with higher Melee Skills and against less intelligent or less agile enemies. Direction of Attack matters now too, it's more difficult to Block attacks from the side and much more so from behind. Some enemies are harder to block than others - but even a Breacher's Melee can be blocked by a skilled fighter!

Shielded Warriors Sprinkled amongst your Ranged and Breaching Mortals can draw Enemy fire and increase your chances for success. They're also great at Holding choke points, even while your other Melee Mortals attack from behind them.

[h3]Edge Highlights[/h3]
We've added a new Post Process to the Renderer that adds subtle edge highlighting.

This brings a nice amount of Contrast to the World, especially in low lighting conditions and brings us one step closer to final visuals for the game.

[i]Look Ma, Fancy Edges![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/8c712ed70ea373ddb7972fb27737188894a13269.png[/img]

[h3]Save Compatibility[/h3]
We wanted to make sure you could submit your existing bases so we've tackled the work to maintain Save Compatibility with this Update. You can carry on with your Kingdom from v0.29 and take the fight to those pesky Kingdoms that have been pestering you for ages.

There are a few things that were changed about the simulation, so starting fresh will yield the best experience going forward.

This also means that we've made it easier to do this, so future updates will maintain compatibility barring catastrophe as well. huzzah!
    
[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
Noble Fates 0.30.0.21 Released!
Noble Fates: Conquest
[code]Crash Fixes

notes.title: Kingdom Crier #40: Noble Fates: Conquest Beta
notes.notes:
Noble Fates: Conquest, the 7th Major Update for Noble Fates lands on 3/11!

[i][b]Conquer your Island via Diplomacy and Warfare![/b][/i]
[i]Submit your base for use by other Kingdoms! v0.29 saves are compatible. Beta starts now![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/488369de453ddc7fa8af60dd9cac3d1333596ca5.png[/img]

[h1]Features[/h1]
[h3]Visit and Raid other Kingdoms[/h3]
Send an Envoy to Improve Relations or Trade

Lead a Raiding Party to Declare War and Conquer your enemies!

[i]Bring the fight to them![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/6815a904671dadc79ee03ea9ac5934862f1ce4d9.gif[/img]

[h3]Conquer your Island[/h3]
The World Map has been updated to reflect each Kingdom's Might, their Holdings, and their known history.

[i]Chilljaw Atoll shall belong to the Orcs![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/7db5f65d94d774ded93e6612d180a2fb57ff11ad.png[/img]

A Kingdom's Holdings expand and contract based on their Strength relative to their neighbors.

Leverage a mix of Diplomacy and Warfare to unite the Island under your Beliefs or take them all out and stand as the only Kingdom, it's your call.

[h3]Engage in Diplomacy[/h3]
Rulers, including your own, can [i]Bend the Knee[/i] and swear Allegiance to another Kingdom to become their Vassals.

Build Influence with them to Negotiate their Allegiance, or beat them into submission and Demand it.

[i]Choose your path...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/a19fef446dc9460d6df18a418dd18bd3237f49c2.png[/img]

Call on them for support in times of need, but don't leave them in the lurch when they call on you!

[h3]Hire Mercenaries[/h3]
Some of the more ingenious Mortals have realized they can turn a profit selling their Skills as Mercenaries.

Place a Deposit and Hire them to expand your Workforce in a pinch...

Or turn your Coins into brute strength to turn the tide of a Battle that isn't going well...

[i]You want how much?!?!?![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/1c7725072cfcd47b8d6dbefe0844c480ebf82da8.png[/img]

Make sure they make it back home to get your Deposit back from the Mercenary Company!

[h3]*NEW* Battering Rams[/h3]
Smacking Walls with Swords and Axes isn't a very effective way to knock them down.

Introducing the Battering Ram, a new Secondary piece of gear that Mortals can use to attack Props for additional Damage. Consequentially, Damage done to Props by Melee Weapons has been reduced.

[i]When a Door is in your way... You must Ram it![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/cf73a5b8fabd1a73a77c13e9ef709192a4553360.png[/img]

Prop Health has been rebalanced to better ensure Doors are (usually!) the weak point of a Structure. That said, a little scouting before engaging can yield weaknesses that are easier to exploit.

When attempting to breach a base, it's best to send a mix of Shields, Battering Rams, Hooks, and Ranged Weapons to Maximize your chance of success.

[h3]*NEW* Fortresses[/h3]
We want the other Kingdoms in your world to live in bases worthy of their stature and to offer interesting Strategic challenges when Raiding, so we've introduced Fortresses.

Fortresses are snapshots of Player bases that can be instanced and used by the other Kingdoms in your world. They layer additional procedural elements and defensive strategies over the top of these to offer a variety of experiences.

To start, we've authored a handful that they can choose from, but this will expand before the full release.

In addition, we've added a Submit Fortress button to the Pause Menu. Use this to Submit your base for consideration to be used as a NPC base! Make sure to include your Contact Info so we can get in touch and give you proper Credit in the... Credits.

[i]Submit your Fortress![/i]

Note: it's best to avoid using Mods that introduce new Structures when building a base for submission as a Fortress, as it will limit your chances of selection.

[h3]*NEW* Reworked Shields[/h3]
Shields have been Reworked to offer more Tactical choice. 

Use of a Shield is now toggleable when equipped. When wielded, the holder draws additional Aggro from nearby enemies, but they attack about half as often, and do not combo their attacks. 

In addition, Blocking has been rebalanced - yielding better results for Mortals with higher Melee Skills and against less intelligent or less agile enemies. Direction of Attack matters now too, it's more difficult to Block attacks from the side and much more so from behind.

Shielded Warriors Sprinkled amongst your Ranged and Breaching Mortals can draw Enemy fire and increase your chances for success. They're also great at Holding choke points, even while your other Melee Mortals attack from behind them.

[h3]*NEW* Edge Highlights[/h3]
We've added a new Post Process to the Renderer that adds subtle edge highlighting.

This brings a nice amount of Contrast to the World, especially in low lighting conditions and brings us one step closer to final visuals for the game.

[i]Look Ma, Fancy Edges![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/8c712ed70ea373ddb7972fb27737188894a13269.png[/img]

[h3]*NEW* Save Compatibility[/h3]
We wanted to make sure you could submit your existing bases so we've tackled the Work to maintain Save Compatibility with this Update. You can carry on with your Kingdom from v0.29 and take the fight to those pesky Kingdoms that have been pestering you for ages.

There are a few things that were changed about the simulation, so starting fresh will yield the best experience going forward.

This also means that we've made it easier to do this, so future updates will maintain compatibility barring catastrophe as well. huzzah!
    
[h3]Other Changes[/h3]
There are a great many other changes included in this update including fixes for longstanding issues.

As always, there will be a few more surprises that land for the release!
    
[h2]Localization[/h2]
Translation for the Update is in progress and will land when it is released.

[h2]Experimental Beta[/h2]
We've dusted off the Experimental Beta branch to put the update through its paces before releasing it more broadly.

notes.title: Kingdom Crier #39: Announcing Noble Fates: Conquest
notes.notes:
The holidays are for sharing, and we thought it would be fitting to share some details about the upcoming Feature Update, titled [b]Conquest[/b].

[i][b]Conquer your Island via Diplomacy and Warfare![/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/d682e04a57807de447425c31b3863b70b6bf8d06.png[/img]

[h1]Features[/h1]
[h3]Visit and Raid other Kingdoms[/h3]
Send an Envoy to Improve Relations.

Lead a Raiding Party to Declare War and Conquer your enemies!

[i]Bring the fight to them![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/b0e49c3a4aa1410114cf684f486be252570460e0.png[/img]

[h3]Engage in Diplomacy[/h3]
Rulers, including your own, can [i]Bend the Knee[/i] and swear Allegiance to another Kingdom to become their Vassal.

Build Influence with them to Negotiate their Allegiance, or beat them into submission and Demand it.

[i]Choose your path...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/cb95202ed7ca29fbaad962f1f3dd37a62eae5b8d.png[/img]

Call on them for support in times of need, but don't leave them in the lurch when they call on you!

[h3]Conquer your Island[/h3]
The World Map has been updated to reflect each Kingdom's Strength and Holdings.

[i]Everyone starts somewhere...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/6be0d1c9b6c6c83bd617b74fb4663992b1079143.png[/img]

A Kingdom's Holdings expand and contract based on their stature relative to their neighbors.

Leverage a mix of Diplomacy and Warfare to unite the Island under your Banner.

[h3]Hire Mercenaries[/h3]
Some of the more ingenious Mortals have realized they can turn a profit selling their Skills as Mercenaries.

Place a Deposit and Hire them to expand your Workforce in a pinch...

Or turn your Coins into brute strength to turn the tide of a Battle that isn't going well...

[i]Take your pick...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/4908652f7186c49198fa4e6ae7c55849ecd1fa4a.png[/img]

Make sure they make it back home to get your Deposit back from the Mercenary Company!

[h3]Other Features[/h3]
There are many other smaller features that we aren't ready to talk about yet, stay tuned for more details!

[h2]Experimental Beta and Release Date[/h2]
This is the largest update to Date, and we're taking our time to make sure it's in great shape before release.

We plan to launch an Experimental Beta early next year, and announce the Release Date at that time.

[h2]Saves[/h2]
As you can imagine, these changes necessitate large changes to the save game format, so this update will retire 0.29 saves.

We'll spin up a retired_0_29 set of Steam Betas so that you can continue your 0.29 saves there or go back and visit them whenever you want.

[h1]The Next Mortal Race...[/h1]
We're still in the ideation phase for the next Mortal Race.

If you haven't submitted your ideas yet, we're still accepting them!

We're looking for a race that will fit into all the existing systems (and clothes!). It'd be cool if they fit around a feature in the game offering a chance to flesh it out further (ala the Dwarves and Mining). Ideally, we'd avoid stepping on the toes of any of the existing Race Mods.

[i]Who is this?[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/84d5610f76d2e7447dbef428b0be102a7b979d14.png[/img]

Some thought starters:
[code]Nocturnal?
Dependency on Consuming Flesh?
Engineers?
Tricksters?
Animalistic?
Different Method of Reproduction?
Farmers?
Ranchers?
[/code]
Let us know what you'd like to see!

Noble Fates is participating in the Steam Winter Sale!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1769420/Noble_Fates/

We're bundled with Diplomacy is Not an Option for an additional discount!

notes.title: Kingdom Crier #38: Cloaks, Mortal Visuals, the next Mortal Race
notes.notes:
Kingdom Crier #38 is here and it brings Cloaks along with it!

In addition, we've done a pass to tighten up the graphics on Mortal Visuals.

Finally, we're nearing work on the fifth Mortal Race and wanted to hear your suggestions before we start!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/a87262ac4769cc46a7c818378fe4bb9484541808.png[/img]

[h1]Today's Content Update[/h1]
[h2]Cloaks[/h2]
Cloaks are the hottest new trend sweeping the Land of Noberia!

Now that they've hit the shores, everyone wants to get their hands on one, and they're in luck - there are 4 tiers to choose from so there are plenty to go around!

[h3]The Poor Cloak[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/f763cc976f1339b09358106a2668b44ad8b0815b.png[/img]

The Poor Cloak is a great starter Cloak, pretty easy to craft. It'll provide a little Prestige, some Warmth, and the gods may even grant it a Buff or two.

[h3]The Modest Cloak[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/f9f5b15cdb5e53074e7813da2e711482585f3668.png[/img]

Modest Cloaks are great for those Kingdoms that have gotten up and running and can start pushing a bit further. More Prestige, more Warmth, more Buffs!

[h3]The Martial Cloak[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/daca875e757d4d0e5d084b6dd298e2e557cfc1f6.png[/img]

Martial Cloaks are most like those that you'd see in the famous series [strike][b]REDACTED[/b][/strike](tm). Even more Prestige, Warmth, and Buffs! They're preferred by Orcs and Dwarves.

[h3]The Royal Cloak[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/e4c96a169840b34be72eeb5f31919b4361848aeb.png[/img]

Finally, we have the Royal Cloak. Just look at this thing!

Every ruler and their Brother will be fighting to get their hands on one. They're dripping with regality. The most Prestige, Warmth, and Buffs! 

Dwarves and Orcs generally don't love these ones.

[h2]Refined Mortal Visuals[/h2]
We've continued the work of dialing in the Mortal Visuals with the goal of finding the right balance between variety, endearment, and goofiness.

Work during this pass primarily centered on identifying and reducing the goofy factor and fine tuning color ranges - especially for Orc Skin. The scientists determined that 25% was the right amount of goofiness - down from the previous 50%.

In addition, we've corrected the oversight that prevented Orcs from being Bald. This was very important!

If you prefer your Mortals goofy, the Visual Extremes Slider has been renamed to Visual Goofiness and you can fine tune it to your heart's content in the Game Options.

[i]Say Cheese[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/0ab1dc1f3c1f8089567b0af9170581acf26abc6f.png[/img]

notes.title: Kingdom Crier #37: Localization, Auto Claim, Sale, Bundles!
notes.notes:
The first official translations have been released with Auto Claim and QOL changes, the roadmap is updated, we're on-sale, and there are a few new bundles to choose from!

Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/6318218f40ae8eccf96b6a3e716617ccbba63573.gif[/img]

[h1]Bundles[/h1]
To celebrate the update, we've partnered with a few interesting games to offer additional discounts.

[i]Medieval Strategy games unite![/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45502/Build_and_Battle_Bundle/

[i]We've partnered with our friends at GSQ Games to bring our games together through 10/31 @ 10a PDT![/i]https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45345/Fates_and_Legends/

[h1]Daily Deal and Sale[/h1]
[i]Noble Fates is featured today and we're celebrating with our biggest Sale to date![/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1769420/Noble_Fates/

[h1]Localization[/h1]
The first Official translation pass is complete. We've added Official support for French, German, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Russian.

Choose the language you'd like to use from the Main Menu. 

NOTE: switching languages does *not* rename Factions, Items, or Places in an existing game.

[i]That [strike]always sensical[/strike] opinion driven dialog that you know and love, available in 6 new flavors![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/2065cdb0157833cb2de8b440ef9e2dfd17e4f06c.png[/img]

[h2]QOL Changes[/h2]
[h3]Expanded Rules[/h3]
The Rules system has been expanded to contain a number of Rules to allow more nuance in consumption, junking, salvaging, and claiming.

[h3]Food and Drink[/h3]
The Food and Drink menu has been rebuilt to be top-down instead of bottom-up with support for Categories, the Expanded Rules System, and option to override settings per Item Type.

[h3]Auto Junk[/h3]
Auto Junk has been greatly expanded using the new Rules system to better facilitate the rules you'd like your people to follow when separating the Items you care about from those that you don't. As with before, you can mark or unmark an item as Junk even when this feature is enabled.

[h3]Auto Salvage[/h3]
Auto Salvage has also come online, courtesy of the Rules System, allowing your Mortals to recycle Items according to your preferences when they don't have anything to do. In addition, you can toggle Salvage per-Item even with this feature enabled.

[h3]Auto Claim (Autonomous Belongings)[/h3]
Most importantly, the Expanded Rules System finally allowed us to tackle Auto Claim (Autonomous Belongings) in a way that we thought would do the feature Justice. 

Rules pull double duty here, allowing you to define the rules that control whether an Item is Claimable as well as the Rules that control whether a Mortal can Claim a Claimable Item.

[i]The Rules... Rule.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/3e88f5113c67e0ffe731982dfa8181117485d411.png[/img]

To start, enable Auto Claim from the Belongings Screen and then click the Claimable: Rules button and the Auto Claim: Rules buttons beside it to customize your Rules.

You can override the Claimable flag on any item at any time. In addition, you can distribute any Items you'd like even while the system is active.

[h3]Selection QOL[/h3]
We've added a popup near the cursor when you can [L Click] or [R Click] again to cycle through targets under the cursor if the Actor you want wasn't selected the first time.

[h3]Controls[/h3]
Finally, we've added support for Edge Scroll and Pitch Inversion (with a separate option for Third Person).

[h3]Other changes[/h3]
There are a bevy of other small changes and fixes included in this update - this is the best playing version of Noble Fates to date!

[h2]Existing Saves[/h2]
Existing Saves should carry over to this Update.

As always, let us know if you're experiencing an issue and we'll get it sorted.

[h1]Translations[/h1]
Our localization providers have kickstarted translations - but we believe that experience players are the best equipped to help refine them.

We've set up a Localization Forum here on Steam to collect Feedback. 

In addition, we've open sourced the Official translations so that you can suggest edits to existing translations or create new ones.

We'll augment community edits with subsequent passes by localization providers at major milestones as needed.

[h2]Edit Official Translations[/h2]
The Official Translations can be found as forks of the NobleFatesLoc github repo:
[url=https://github.com/xobermon/NobleFatesLoc-French]NobleFatesLoc-French[/url]
[url=https://github.com/xobermon/NobleFatesLoc-German]NobleFatesLoc-German[/url]
[url=https://github.com/xobermon/NobleFatesLoc-Japanese]NobleFatesLoc-Japanese[/url]
[url=https://github.com/xobermon/NobleFatesLoc-Korean]NobleFatesLoc-Korean[/url]
[url=https://github.com/xobermon/NobleFatesLoc-ChineseSimplified]NobleFatesLoc-ChineseSimplified[/url]
[url=https://github.com/xobermon/NobleFatesLoc-Russian]NobleFatesLoc-Russian[/url]

Fork these and make any edits you'd like. Create Pull Requests to send them back up the chain to us for evaluation.

Active Contributors can apply to become Moderators for Official Languages - let us know if you're interested.

[h2]Create New Translations[/h2]
To create a new translation, fork the [url=https://github.com/xobermon/NobleFatesLoc]NobleFatesLoc[/url] github repo and follow the directions therein.

Unofficial Translations can apply to become official when they're ready.

[h1]Mods[/h1]

[h3]Mod Localization[/h3]
In addition, Mods now support localization.

See this [url=https://discord.com/channels/705502476572557452/918916095509942282/1281760343902650421]post[/url] for details.

Finally, we now support Localization Mods. These mods can add new Languages, replace or expand on existing translations, or supply translations for mods.

See [url=]this post[/url] for details.

notes.notes:
Kingdom Crier #36 is here with BETA access to French, German, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Russian translations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/aa1e08b53238b17dc23fcc01c8544c66afa531de.jpg[/img]

[h1]Localization BETA[/h1]
The first pass translations are in and initial localization support is nearly complete, so we're ready for some fresh eyes to take a look.

French, German, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Russian translations are available now on the Experimental branch for you to play.

Any and all feedback is welcome.

[h2]Experimental Branch[/h2]
To check it out - switch to (or stay in) the Experimental Beta on Steam and participate in discussions [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1769420/discussions/1/]here[/url] or on discord.

Expect occasional issues - but know that we appreciate you helping us make the game better!

[h2]Existing Saves[/h2]
Existing Saves will carry over to this build and forward along with it when it releases.

There's a one-time update to the format of text that will cause some existing text to continue untranslated, but any new text will be translated properly.

This format change means saves migrated to this version cannot return to v0.29.6.*.

[h2]Changing Language Mid-game[/h2]
Changing Language mid-game will update most text, however places, factions, and items will retain their previous names.

[h2]Mods[/h2]
Mod support is VERY Experimental at the moment - expect some mods to crash or to have issues - we plan to evaluate them more closely during the beta.

Please report issues you find!

[h3]UPDATE [8/15][/h3]
Mods are now fully compatible! Enjoy!

[h1]What's next[/h1]
We view this as just the starting point for Localization for Noble Fates.

We plan to open source the translations via github during the BETA. Once online, you will be able to leverage your knowledge of the game to refine existing translations and provide new ones during the lag time between Official Updates.

In addition, we plan to strengthen support for Mods, allowing them to be localized and for them to provide new languages that aren't already covered by the game.

Finally, we plan to kick off subsequent languages when the community expresses enough interest.

notes.title: Kingdom Crier #35: Retooled Guided Experience and Paths!
notes.notes:
Kingdom Crier #35 is here with an updated Guided Experience, Decorative Paths, a few QOL changes, and a Localization Progress Report!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/5f786cbe4b670306892309016416c6891ad2caa5.png[/img]

[h1]Guided Experience[/h1]
The Guided Experience has been retooled so that all functionality is available from the start to better reflect the full experience.

The conversation step has been reworked to focus on recruitment to better align with its role in the game.

In addition, there's a new UI that reflects progress with the ability to skip to the Next Step or End the Guided Experience in-game!

[i]Schnazzy![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/ef8b2c4c8069edce10a955796e9b157a1f8327ee.png[/img]

[h1]Decorative Paths[/h1]
We've added Decorative Paths to help give your Mortals proper paths between your Buildings.

[i]Dress up those entryways...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/d697ef8c6c3dd300e39ec99cdb62c9e1b930a236.gif[/img]

[i]Or leverage the cusomization options to make a zen Garden![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/ad11f2e6797ee44af25d9ac3b2283b808eb7f296.png[/img]

We've had early discussions about the roles Slopes, Floors, and Paths could play in movement speed but it's a sizeable chunk of work, so it's on the list of things we're considering for now.

[h1]New Grass![/h1]
We've updated the Dense Grass Visuals.

[i]They also better reflect Density - nice work Matt![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/2be3edb63bfb90cfd3c052919262d4a3b02db9ea.png[/img]

[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]
[h3]Camera[/h3]
The Camera will now pan and rotate a little slower when zoomed in by default (tunable in the options).

As a bonus, height adjustments are now much less jarring. Embrace Verticality!

[h3]Dangerous Animals[/h3]
Dangerous Animals now act as a pack. This simplifies the logistics of clearing them off your lands.

[b]NOTE:[/b] This also makes them more... uh... Dangerous. Be careful out there!

[h3]Confirmation Barks[/h3]
Mortals will now Vocalize when you order them to do something using their voice and pitch!

[h3]Imp Invasions[/h3]
We improved the performance both before and during Imp Invasions.

We halved the quantity (but not quality) of the loot they generate to lessen the burden of cleanup afterwards and improve mid-game balance.

[h3]Injuries[/h3]
Treatment Commands are not automatically issued for Injuries that need treatment. 

Use Orders to assign your preferred Nurse or cancel the Command if you'd like to wait.

notes.title: Kingdom Crier #34: Fantastical Architecture!
notes.notes:
Kingdom Crier #34 is here. Introducing Fantastical Architecture, a Content Update that dropped today!

[h1]Fantastical Architecture[/h1]
Hey, let's make it easier to build awe inspiring structures!

[i]All Reachable without scaffolding![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/e62ea864b8caa1d627f768316046a065b174cc7d.png[/img]

[h2]Expanded Reachability[/h2]
All Props that are touching one-another are now considered part of the same Structure under the hood. Operating (Building, Repairing, Rebuilding, Refueling, Depositing, Cleaning, Researching, Uncrating, and Fire Fighting) on any exterior Prop that is part of that Structure can be done if any part of the exterior of the Structure can be reached. Operating on any interior Prop that is part of the Structure can be done from any space in the same Room (or Rooms in the case of Walls and Floors).

Dismantling and Crating use a special, cached, version of their Structure and Rooms that maintain reachability for the duration of the Command even if the intervening pieces have already been removed.

This means that they can build a giant wall as long as they can reach the base of it! They can attach awesome decorative pieces to the highest point on your Castle from the closest point they can get to. They can repair that tattered Flag on the roof from below! You throw down the Blueprints and your people make it happen.

Attacking and Using a Prop still require direct access using the previous System.

Stepping back, the aim is to take the guesswork and logistical headache out of Building (and maintaining!) awesome Buildings. We're intentionally hand waving over the fine details of how (I like to think they're adept climbers :P) to save us a great deal of development time and maximize your creativity and freedom of expression.

if you'd prefer to stick with the old system, there's a set of Options for Building, Repairing, and Rebuilding that you can disable to return to the prior mechanisms for any of them. You could make Building require scaffolding, while maintaining the benefits for Repairing and Rebuilding, for example.

From our perspective, this fits right in with our Fantasy driven Kingdom Builder - right along with the intentional decision to not include a stability system. We want to enable you to lean into the Fantastical Architecture when it comes to building - preferring cool looking buildings and maximizing expression to absolute realism.

[h2]Planning[/h2]
As you may surmise, calculating the fine details of this can require some horsepower - but we put a lot of work into ensuring it's even faster than the prior system.

The plan for any given Prop is refined over time. This may mean that they choose a suboptimal point if they go to work on it right away in favor of Reachability, but the access point will be refined over time. The longer the plan is outstanding, the better the plan.

[i]Cyan - usable points on the Structure[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/61b593c6dca6a56254238ca8d415bb433b8272d0.png[/img]

In addition, you may rarely see a Prop marked as Planning - this means they haven't surmised a workable position yet - but they're working on it! Check back in a bit.

[h2]Angled Walls[/h2]
Oh hey, new toys!

Logistically, they work like Parapets, meaning they can be hopped (well at least the are now after we fixed Mantling...).

They can overlap with true Short Walls as well as Portcullises...? Portcullisese...? Portcullisi...? Portculi... pines...? Portcullises.

[h2][strike]Arches[/strike] Braces[/h2]
We expanded on the Arches category and added options for Wood.

In addition, we made these no longer block Movement.

Also, they're now allowed to overlap with Short Walls.

[h2]Water[/h2]
Previously, it was impossible to build below the surface of Water.

Now, leveraging Expanded Reachability, they can operate on Props below the surface as long as they can reach something above the waterline.

[i]Use this to make cool Bridges![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/cce438c1099173df31132d1fe07ac702c52dd6bc.png[/img]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
Finally, we resolved a number of issues related to Building - improving Cursor placement, Exhaust Building, Multilayer Roofs, and more.

[i]Oh and we fixed the Blueprint Sorting issue with Particles.[/i]

[h1]Bulk Work Tools[/h1]
Next, we expanded the Work Menu and added the long asked for Bulk Work Tools.

[i]Get to Work![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/37b63a82e40006f52b38d3f8ea2427beb395d27f.png[/img]

[h2]Cancel[/h2]
Use this to Cancel individual Commands (including Constructs) by clicking on them, or Marquee Select to Choose what to Cancel!

[h2]Cut[/h2]
Use this to Cut Trees, Grass, Bushes, whatever.

[i]Hint: Use Sustainable Trees option to select a subset of the Mature Trees, leaving room for others to fill in the gaps[/i]

[i]Hint x2: Sustainable is also great for 'caps![/i]

[h2]Dismantle[/h2]
Use this to bulk Dismantle a structure.

[h2]Forage[/h2]
Use this to Forage those yummy Octoberberries.

[h2]Gather[/h2]
This one will Gather Wood, Stone, or Metal from things laying about.

[h1]Other Stuff[/h1]
[h3]Temperature[/h3]
We increased the accuracy of the interior Temperature Sim - especially for large Kingdoms and at high speeds.

[h3]Any Schedule Slots[/h3]
Any Schedule slots were always choosing Work over Relaxation. oops! 

Beware the [i]completely unrelated[/i] increase in casual Yodeling! 

[h3]Marquee Selection[/h3]
Marquee Selection now includes a Search Box that is highlighted by default, start typing and it'll filter the options.

[h3]Active Abilities[/h3]
We greatly decreased the frequency of Active Ability audio Pings. 

[h3]Animal List[/h3]
We made the Animal List always include animals you've seen before.

[h3]Conquests[/h3]
Conquests are now a little more fair.

[h3]Opinion Tooltips[/h3]
Opinion Tooltips now have width limits and support multiple lines for those of you with big Kingdoms and long names.

[h3]Camera[/h3]
The Camera will now behave better over Water.

[h3]Performance[/h3]
A good deal of performance work was tackled while we worked on this update. You should see gains in most scenarios.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

        Examples
            The top of large wall...

            A Chimney poking through the center of the roof...

notes.title: Kingdom Crier #33: Choose Your Fate is here!
notes.notes:
The Choose Your Fate Feature Update is here!

Grow a Family that carries your Kingdom's Legacy through the Ages... 

[previewyoutube=Qo9s-fz0jlo;full][/previewyoutube]

Ascend and start a new Kingdom in the same World via customizable Origin Stories.

[h1]Families![/h1]
Every Mortal now belongs to a Family. 

[h2]Yodeling 101[/h2]
Two interested Adult Mortals that have access to a Double Bed can Yodel with one another.

[i]Spending some quality time together...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/7742aed2bb60d214a920fee7cfe182b39dc5acd1.gif[/img]

A Fertile Male and Female pair of Yodelers have a chance of producing a Pregnancy.

[h2]Genetics[/h2]
When born, a Baby becomes one of their parent's Races with equal odds.

A variable amount of each Parent's appearance, preferences, and potential is inherited at the appropriate stages of development.

[h2]Stages[/h2]
[h3]Baby[/h3]
Babies can't really do anything other than Eat, Sleep, Cry, and Poo. They can't even rule.

[i]Just look at it... Pathetic.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/c8aabb8b9a8df0d926bd93ac749f5aec219b1df4.png[/img]

Instead of Esteem, Babies have Mood. Their mood is driven by satisfaction of their basic Needs. 

[h3]Child[/h3]
Children have newly formed raw Alignment and Opinions.

Their mood is driven by an increased set of Needs. 

[i]What's for dinner?[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/1536461b09cd679d699c95e4035a37ec2d306d2e.png[/img]

They can help out with Work but aren't very skilled so they're better off Training. 

[h3]Juvenile[/h3]
When a Mortal becomes a Juvenile, they become more proficient at working.

A healthy balance of Esteem, Training, and Work maximizes their Development.

[i]Say Cooked Orc![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/51cda17a47747b03ed5d31366c4da9a09fb80f1a.png[/img]

They hold Esteem towards your Ruler and can choose to Desert or Defect.

[h3]Adult[/h3]
When a Mortal becomes an Adult, their Sexuality comes online and they yearn for a Partner of their own.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/361106a2a855bb7ebaeddd68d33f4525b3f77b29.png[/img]

[h2]Development[/h2]
A balanced childhood yields Development Points for the Mortal.

They experience a Growth Moment at each stage of development where you can spend them on Traits.

[i]Bleed more or Bleed less? Hrmmmmm...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/840714cd30b9e1e09b5cd851a076a97cce62a27f.png[/img]

These can affect anything from how much they Sleep to how often they'll bug you with specific Wants!

[h2]Family Trees[/h2]
We've introduced Family Trees to offer insight into the relationships within your World.

[i]You can't talk to me that way, I'm a 6th Generation Barf![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/3f67e88bb7e492cc3b9dc995b547d6e031be45a5.png[/img]

You can access a Mortal's Family Tree from their Mortal Sheet or the World Map.

[h2]Marriage[/h2]
When Married, the Mortal with lesser Prestige prefers to join the family of the Mortal with more Prestige.

[h2]Legitimacy[/h2]
A child born to parents out of wedlock is Illegitimate.

They carry the Bast surname until they become an Adult.

It's not all bad though, they get to choose a Name and start a new Family of their own once they get there!

[h2]Biological Age[/h2]
We've reworked the display of Age to show the Biological Age of any given Mortal.

This normalized Age makes it easier to tell how far they are along in their life's journey.

Hovering over it will show their Chronological Age and Lifespan.

[h3]Orcs[/h3]
Along those lines, we've shortened the Lifespan of Orcs to .65x that of Humans.

They progress more quickly through all of the Development stages and Leveling, bringing an interesting new option to the table.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/2852e2d5493bfb16675c44b0e9f63dc7ec379997.png[/img]

[h2]Succession[/h2]
Succession has been reworked to prioritize passing the crown to the first Legitimate Heir.

[h2]Simulation[/h2]
Marriage and Reproduction are now Simulated for all the other Kingdoms and Families in your world!

[h1]Training[/h1]
We've greatly expanded the Training system to support the Development of Children.

[h2]Studying[/h2]
Introducing Studying!

Queue up the appropriate Book Set at a Lectern and a Mortal assigned to that Job and with sufficient Skill will author a Book Set. 

You can also buy them off of wealthy Visitors.

[i]A little light reading.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/e831a8e49fdf4116b5053b09202e61d03e9540c2.png[/img]

Place it in the World and Mortals can Study to develop their Skills!

[h2]Priorities and Scheduling[/h2]
We've expanded the Jobs and Schedule Systems to give you better control over this.

Training is now a separate assignable Job.

You can control the priority and Schedule using the appropriate Tabs.

What they Train is dictated by the Training Tab.

[h2]Ranged[/h2]
Oh, and we fixed Ranged Combat training.

[i]bowbowbowbow[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/a8251c65a0dcc480272ff87a2f2559676b24e948.gif[/img]

[h1]New Beds and Cribs[/h1]
We've fleshed out the Bed options to make sure there are plenty of options for Yodeling.

[i]We've got something for everyone![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/84c1e5f1e447dea0a0723865b3e4db6780fd35dd.png[/img]

In addition, there are now Cribs that are more difficult to build but yield greater Sleep Quality (and thus more Development Points) for your babies!

[h1]The Choose Your Fate Scenario[/h1]
Finally, we've introduced the Choose Your Fate starting Scenario and flow.

[h2]The Living World[/h2]
You begin with the Living World view.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/9693aca0d31d1b29c94c741205ef61413f916f17.gif[/img]

Control time on a greater scale and watch the rise and fall of Kingdoms and Families with a new window into the underlying Simulation.

[h2]Emergent Origin Stories[/h2]
Origin Stories that emerge from the Living World are offered up as potential starting points.

Choose and customize one of these to start with a bit of back story from your World.

[h2]Custom Origin Stories[/h2]
Or choose one of the Potential Home sites to setup a Custom Origin of your own to start with.

[i]Origin Customization...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/35a2e6d80a08eea3ff97bafdf55e79dfe50439dc.png[/img]

[h2]Ascend[/h2]
Once Playing, you are now given the opportunity to Ascend at key moments.

Ascending leaves your current Kingdom behind and returns you to the Living World.

From there, you can choose your next Origin within the same World.

You can even choose your old Kingdom as your Enemy if they're still around!

[h2]Genetics[/h2]
When born, a Child will be one of either of their parent's Races.

A variable amount of each Parent's appearance, preferences, and potential is inherited at the appropriate stages of development.

[h2]Stages[/h2]
[h3]Baby[/h3]
Babies can't really do anything other than Eat, Sleep, Cry, and Scat. They can't even rule.

[i]Just look at it... Pathetic.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/c8aabb8b9a8df0d926bd93ac749f5aec219b1df4.png[/img]

Instead of Esteem, Babies have Mood. Their mood is driven by satisfaction of their basic Needs. 

[h3]Child[/h3]
Children have newly formed raw Alignment and Opinions.

Their mood is driven by an increased set of Needs. 

[i]What's for dinner?[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/1536461b09cd679d699c95e4035a37ec2d306d2e.png[/img]

They can help out with Work but aren't very skilled so they're better off Training. 

[h3]Juvenile[/h3]
When a Mortal becomes a Juvenile, they become more proficient at working.

A healthy balance of Esteem, Training, and Work maximizes their Development.

[i]with the 'rents circa 421[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/c2122f0028ee21fdcaca1b76449f57b422e1960b.png[/img]

They hold Esteem towards your Ruler and can choose to Desert or Defect.

[h3]Adult[/h3]
When a Mortal becomes an Adult, their Sexuality comes online and they yearn for a Partner of their own.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/361106a2a855bb7ebaeddd68d33f4525b3f77b29.png[/img]

[h2]Development[/h2]
A balanced childhood yields Development Points for the Mortal.

They experience a Growth Moment at each stage of development where you can spend them on Traits.

[i]Bleed more or Bleed less? Hrmmmmm...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/840714cd30b9e1e09b5cd851a076a97cce62a27f.png[/img]

These can affect anything from how much they Sleep to how often they'll bug you with specific Wants!

[h2]Family Trees[/h2]
We've introduced Family Trees to offer insight into the relationships within your World.

[i]You can't talk to me that way, I'm a 6th Generation Barf![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/3f67e88bb7e492cc3b9dc995b547d6e031be45a5.png[/img]

You can access a Mortal's Family Tree from their Mortal Sheet or the World Map.

[h2]Marriage[/h2]
When Married, the Mortal with lesser Prestige prefers to join the family of the Mortal with more Prestige.

[h2]Legitimacy[/h2]
A child born to parents out of wedlock is Illegitimate.

They carry the Bast surname until they become an Adult.

It's not all bad though, they get to choose a Name and start a new Family of their own once they get there!

[h2]Biological Age[/h2]
We've reworked the display of Age to show the Biological Age of any given Mortal.

This normalized Age makes it easier to tell how far they are along in their life's journey.

Hovering over it will show their Chronological Age and Lifespan.

[h3]Orcs[/h3]
Along those lines, we've shortened the Lifespan of Orcs to .65x that of Humans.

They progress more quickly through all of the Development stages and Leveling, bringing an interesting new option to the table.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/2852e2d5493bfb16675c44b0e9f63dc7ec379997.png[/img]

[h2]Succession[/h2]
Succession has been reworked to prioritize passing the crown to the first Legitimate Heir.

[h2]Simulation[/h2]
Marriage and Reproduction are now Simulated for all the other Kingdoms and Families in your world!

[h1]Training[/h1]
We've greatly expanded the Training system to support the Development of Children.

[h2]Studying[/h2]
Introducing Studying!

Queue up the appropriate Book Set at a Lectern and a Mortal assigned to that Job and with sufficient Skill will author a Book Set. 

You can also buy them off of wealthy Visitors.

[i]A little light reading.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/e831a8e49fdf4116b5053b09202e61d03e9540c2.png[/img]

Place it in the World and Mortals can Study to develop their Skills!

[h2]Priorities and Scheduling[/h2]
We've expanded the Jobs and Schedule Systems to give you better control over this.

Training is now a separate assignable Job.

You can control the priority and Schedule using the appropriate Tabs.

What they Train is dictated by the Training Tab.

[h2]Ranged[/h2]
Oh, and we fixed Ranged Combat training.

[i]bowbowbowbow[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/a8251c65a0dcc480272ff87a2f2559676b24e948.gif[/img]

[h1]The Choose Your Fate Scenario[/h1]
Finally, we've introduced the Choose Your Fate starting Scenario and flow.

[h2]The Living World[/h2]
You begin with the Living World view.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/9693aca0d31d1b29c94c741205ef61413f916f17.gif[/img]

Control time on a greater scale and watch the rise and fall of Kingdoms and Families with a new window into the underlying Simulation.

[h2]Emergent Origin Stories[/h2]
Origin Stories seeded from the Living World are offered up as potential starting points.

Choose and customize one of these to start with a bit of back story from your World.

[h2]Custom Origin Stories[/h2]
Or choose one of the Potential Home sites to setup a Custom Origin of your own to start with.

[i]Origin Customization...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/e5e6e069e60fd4d61d1defa637bd447fe6dba321.png[/img]

[h2]Ascend[/h2]
Once Playing, you are now given the opportunity to Ascend at key moments.

Ascending leaves your current Kingdom behind and returns you to the Living World.

From there, you can choose your next Origin within the same World.

You can even fight your old Kingdom if they're still around!

[h1]Release Date[/h1]
The update will launch on 3/12 at 10a PST.
    
[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
There are a many other changes included in this update including some that will come online during the Experimental Beta.

We'll release full patch notes when the update is released.

[h2]Saves[/h2]
These changes necessitated large changes to the save game format, so this update will retire 0.28 saves.

We'll spin up a retired_0_28 set of Steam Betas so that you can continue your 0.28 saves there or go back and visit them whenever you want.
    
[h2]Mods[/h2]
It's quite likely that the update will cause compatibility issues with some mods - especially those introducing new Races.

We'll use the Experimental Beta to iron out the kinks.

[h2]Experimental Beta[/h2]
We're dusting off the Experimental Beta branch to put the update through its paces before releasing it more broadly.

Saves from the Experimental Beta will carry over when the full update releases.

You can participate by switching to the Experimental Beta on Steam. Expect issues - but know that we appreciate you helping pave the way for a smooth launch!

[h1]Discord[/h1]
Join the Official [url=https://discord.gg/HeAaQcS]Discord[/url] to participate in Development!
[url=https://discord.gg/HeAaQcS][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/a54c50c85ab2d954f641161dab4a43e3e8c37ad2.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Reviews[/h1]
If you like the game, please consider leaving a Review for the game if you haven't already. These help players that may be on the fence to decide whether or not to support us.


Thanks for reading and thanks for playing!
The Noble Fates Team
